# Tokeness Docs

> Tokeness is an AI API gateway. Use one API key to call multiple AI models through an OpenAI-compatible interface. Manage API keys, quota, balance, and usage logs from the Tokeness console.
>
> Base URL: https://n.tokeness.io/v1
> Console: https://tokeness.io
> Docs: https://docs.tokeness.io
>
> Generated from scripts/llms-manifest.mjs. Do not edit this file directly.

## Core Facts

- [关于 Tokeness](https://docs.tokeness.io/zh/about): Canonical product facts, API endpoint, billing model, supported integration types, and official links.
- [常见问题](https://docs.tokeness.io/zh/faq): Tokeness FAQ covering Base URL, auth errors, balance, model names, billing, Claude Code, and supported tools.
- [模型与计费](https://docs.tokeness.io/zh/billing/pricing): Pre-paid billing model, usage logs, model price policy, and cost control guidance.

## Getting Started

- [开始接入](https://docs.tokeness.io/zh/guide/getting-started): Minimum onboarding flow: log in, top up, create API key, copy model name, and make a test call.
- [API 密钥](https://docs.tokeness.io/zh/guide/api-keys): API Key management, project separation, quota control, and safe key handling.
- [控制台概览](https://docs.tokeness.io/zh/guide/dashboard): Console pages for overview, usage logs, wallet, and troubleshooting.
